title: DTFD-MIL: Double-Tier Feature Distillation Multiple Instance Learning for Histopathology Whole Slide Image Classification
study_context: MIL with few slides and many patches.
task: MIL with few slides and many patches.
main_findings: DTFD-MIL partitions slide instances into pseudo-bags for two-tier learning.
limitations: Pseudo-bags do not create independent patients or positive clinical events.
Review covers the cited pages; quantitative tables require further source verification.
does_not_establish: No increased independent clinical sample size or SMC validation.
relevance_to_project: Small-cohort MIL comparator while retaining patient grouping.
